title: The Martel family band and its members
summary: Joe describes the all-family Martel band: Albert Martel on soprano sax, Bert on trumpet, Dayton on trombone, Millard on drums and a banjo-playing daughter.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Joe Darensbourg, Tape 2, April 18, 1984. You were telling me about Martel...

The Martel band. You were asking me how I happened to start with that band. It just came to me... Martel was a family band. It was all family members. The girl, a banjo player... She played banjo. They had two banjos. One of the boys, Dayton Martel, played the trombone, and Berton Martel played the trumpet or cornet or whatever you call it, Millard Martel played drums, and they didn't have a piano. Old man Martel was the leader of the band, although Bert played...his son played trumpet. He played a little B-flat soprano saxophone, and he played the lead.
What was his first name? Do you remember?
